ui.medical.label: Name on the card
ui.medical.refrigeration: Needs to stay cold (medication), not power directly
ui.medical.noDiagnosis: No diagnosis is needed. Only what the equipment is.

ui.medical.backupFooter: Turn on "Works with" only if the supplier or manufacturer confirmed it.
ui.medical.runtimeHours: Hours, from the manufacturer or care plan
ui.medical.runtimeFooter: Leave empty if you don't know. Dry Run never estimates how long a device or a person can go without power.

ui.onboarding.headline: Be ready together before an emergency.
ui.onboarding.body: Know what to prepare next, practice what your family would do in your own home, and keep a plan you can open, share or print without the internet.
ui.onboarding.point1: Practice a fire, flood, freeze or other emergency in your own home, one decision at a time.
ui.onboarding.point2: Get the few preparations that matter most, plus an emergency card with contacts, meeting places and critical needs.
ui.onboarding.demoNote: Uses a made-up family. Nothing is saved about you.
ui.onboarding.sampleHint: Loads a made-up household and sample home
ui.setup.area.question: Which language and county?
ui.setup.area.why: Your county picks the local help numbers. Your address is not needed.
ui.setup.people.question: Who lives here?
ui.setup.people.why: Nicknames are fine. Recording needs lets the rehearsal plan who helps whom; no diagnosis is needed.
ui.setup.medical.question: Does anyone rely on powered medical equipment or medication that must stay cold?
ui.setup.medical.why: For example oxygen, CPAP, a power wheelchair, or insulin. This matters most in a power outage.
ui.setup.medical.none: If no one does, tap Next.
ui.setup.backup.question: Do you have any backup power?
ui.setup.backup.why: A battery station, generator, or solar with battery. Say whether it works with each device, but only if the supplier confirmed it.
ui.setup.home.question: How is your home heated and where does your water come from?
ui.setup.home.why: These decide what stops working when the power goes out.
ui.setup.contacts.question: Who should people call?
ui.setup.contacts.why: An out-of-area contact everyone can reach, and the equipment supplier or care team.
ui.setup.travel.question: Getting around, pets, and supplies
ui.setup.travel.why: Leave anything you're not sure about. You can change it later.
ui.setup.countyFooter: Only your county is used to choose public resources. It stays on this phone.
ui.setup.heatNeedsPower: Heat needs electricity (controls, blower, or electric heat)
ui.setup.heatFooter: Many gas furnaces still need electricity for the blower or controls. If you're not sure, choose Not sure.
ui.setup.noCarFooter: No car is a fully supported plan. Arranging a ride ahead of time matters more than owning one.
family.title: Family emergency card
family.contactMissing: Add a trusted contact and phone number
family.backupMeetup: Backup meeting place outside the neighborhood
family.name: Name (optional)
family.selectedWhy: The preview shows exactly what will be shared. Your own notes are not translated.
family.refrigeration: Does this medicine need refrigerated storage?
family.power: Does it also require electrical power directly?
family.providerPrompt: Follow the label and ask the pharmacist, clinician or manufacturer about storage and backup instructions. No safe interruption time is estimated here.
family.addressPrivacy: Optional. As you type, Apple Maps suggests matching addresses. The address you save is stored encrypted on this phone.
family.alarmNote: Record presence, location and a functional check separately. A marker does not establish whole-home coverage.
family.extinguisherNote: Know its accessible location. Children and untrained people should leave; do not stay to fight a spreading fire.
prep.smokeAlarms.title: Check smoke alarms
prep.smokeAlarms.why: Record alarm locations, coverage still to review, and an actual functional check.
prep.coAlarms.title: Check CO alarms
prep.coAlarms.why: Record presence, location and an actual functional check separately.
prep.extinguisher.title: Locate the fire extinguisher
prep.extinguisher.why: Make its accessible location known; leaving a spreading fire comes first.
prep.clearExits.title: Check doors and escape options
prep.clearExits.why: Record a physical check; a window alone is not a confirmed usable escape route.
prep.water.title: Store drinking water
prep.water.why: Storage planning target: {target} for your household for three days; not a clinical drinking prescription.
prep.contact.title: Add a trusted contact
prep.contact.why: A name and usable phone let someone reconnect with your family.
prep.outOfAreaContact.title: Add an out-of-area contact
prep.outOfAreaContact.why: Choose someone outside your area who can help family members reconnect.
prep.nearMeetup.title: Choose an outside meeting place
prep.nearMeetup.why: Choose a recognizable spot near home for a household escape plan.
prep.backupMeetup.title: Choose a backup meeting place
prep.backupMeetup.why: Pick a location outside the neighborhood in case you cannot return home.
prep.layout.title: Add your home layout when ready
prep.layout.why: Your card works now. Spatial practice needs a reviewed personal layout.
prep.helper.title: Plan assistance for {person}
prep.helper.why: Agree on support in advance; nobody is assigned to re-enter danger.
prep.medicalBackup.title: Check backup for {device}
prep.medicalBackup.why: Record compatibility, source setup, relevant placement/output requirements and documented runtime separately.
prep.coldStorage.title: Record storage instructions for {device}
prep.coldStorage.why: Check medicine-specific instructions with the label or pharmacist; do not infer a safe interruption time.
prep.food.title: Store food for your household
prep.food.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
prep.firstAid.title: Locate your first-aid kit
prep.firstAid.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
prep.flashlight.title: Locate flashlights
prep.flashlight.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
prep.batteries.title: Check batteries or a power bank
prep.batteries.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
prep.sanitation.title: Prepare sanitation supplies
prep.sanitation.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
prep.reconnect.title: Agree how to reconnect
prep.reconnect.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
prep.floodPlan.title: Review a flood preparation plan
prep.floodPlan.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
prep.heatCold.title: Prepare for heat and cold
prep.heatCold.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
prep.transport.title: Agree on a usable transport plan
prep.transport.why: Record an agreed way to travel, including confirmed accessibility when someone uses a wheelchair.
prep.pets.title: Prepare pet essentials
prep.pets.why: Record what you have, where to find it, and the relevant household arrangement.
map.privacy: Apple handles map searches and ordinary directions. Suggestions do not confirm stock, opening, shelter activation, or a safe evacuation route.
map.dropPin: Use map center as a pin
map.textPlace: Add a place without a pin
map.title: Neighborhood planning
map.noHome: Add an optional home address or search for a place. Planning does not need GPS permission.
map.mapSummary: Home and saved places; equivalent details in List
map.empty: No suggestions found. Search a name, expand the radius, or keep a text-only place.
map.offline: Saved names, addresses and instructions stay available offline. Fresh search, directions and map tiles require Apple services.
map.routeNote: Ordinary directions are planning aids. Road conditions and accessibility may differ in an emergency.
map.suggestionNote: Apple search suggestion; check the facility and its service directly.
map.originMissing: Choose a saved origin or allow current location when requested.
map.routeError: Apple could not provide that route. Try another travel mode; your saved plan is unchanged.
map.label: Place name
map.saveError: Save failed. Your draft is still here; try again.
map.searchError: Apple search is unavailable. You can enter text or a pin manually.
map.addressPrivacy: An address is optional. Searches go to Apple; no GPS permission is needed. Your family and medical records stay in the private vault.
map.countryCode: Country code, for example US or VN
map.unknownMetadata: Unknown city, region and country stay unknown. Apple administrative names do not establish supported official resource coverage.
map.invalidPin: Enter both valid latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
map.layoutMissing: No home layout added. The family card and preparations work now; indoor routes need a reviewed layout.
map.noHousehold: Add your household to start a family plan.
family.storagePlan: Storage arrangement confirmed against these instructions
card.gap.storageInstructionsUnknown: Medicine-specific storage instructions are not recorded.
card.gap.storagePlanUnconfirmed: A storage arrangement following those instructions is not confirmed.
family.powerBankCharges: Documented full phone charges from power bank
family.reviewedTogether: We reviewed the family information together
map.moveNote: Moving keeps your family, contacts, equipment and general supplies. It clears this home layout, room assignments, meeting places and home-specific checks.
family.alarmCoverage: Alarm coverage reviewed for this home’s rooms and levels
map.diagramScope: Home diagrams include your room names. Custom annotation labels are included only with Critical information; private notes use their separate control.
family.storageConfirmed: Storage arrangement recorded as confirmed against these instructions
family.itemRefrigeration: Does this item need refrigerated storage? Review the earlier answer.
prep.reviewCard.title: Review the family card
prep.reviewCard.why: Check your family details, contacts and meeting places together. DryRun uses a 180-day review prompt; changes can need an earlier review.
prep.recheck.why: The last recorded check is over {days} days old. Recheck using the item’s instructions and record the date. This planning prompt does not establish protection.
family.reviewNow: We reviewed this card and its contacts today
reminder.title: Optional review reminder
reminder.optional: Choose a one-time local reminder if it helps. Nothing is scheduled until you tap Schedule. Notifications contain only a general review prompt.
reminder.notificationBody: Check that your contacts, meeting places and preparation records are current.
reminder.saved: Review reminder scheduled on this device.
reminder.denied: Notifications are off for Dry Run. You can enable them in system Settings; your plan still works without reminders.
reminder.invalidDate: Choose a future date and time.
reminder.failed: The reminder could not be saved. Your selected date was kept; try again.
prep.radio.title: Plan a way to receive alerts
prep.radio.why: Record a battery or crank radio, or an agreed alternative, and where to find it.
prep.alerts.title: Set up local alerts
prep.alerts.why: For supported local coverage, record your actual alert enrollment and how to receive it.
prep.medication.title: Check essential medication availability
prep.medication.why: Record the availability and location of essential medication for {person}; follow the label and pharmacist’s instructions.
prep.equipmentSupplies.title: Check essential equipment supplies
prep.equipmentSupplies.why: Record the availability and location of required supplies for {device}; use manufacturer or provider instructions.
prep.location.why: You have recorded having this preparation: {item}. Add where to find it or the agreed instructions.
family.radioAlternative: Record radio ownership above. Below, you can instead confirm an agreed way to receive alerts, with finding or access instructions.
family.medicationAvailability: Record only availability and where to find the medicine. Follow its labeling and check missing instructions with a pharmacist or clinician.
family.equipmentSupplies: Use the manufacturer or provider’s list of required supplies. Ownership of supplies does not confirm equipment backup compatibility.
prep.fireDrill.title: Practice leaving home together
prep.fireDrill.why: Record a real family fire-escape drill and the plan you practiced. A digital exercise or an exit check alone is not a household drill.
prep.wellFloodPlan.title: Plan well testing after a flood
prep.wellFloodPlan.why: Record whom to contact about well testing after flooding and how to reach them. This planning record does not mean the water has been tested or is safe.
prep.waterUtility.title: Add your water utility contact
prep.waterUtility.why: Keep a named water utility and usable phone number for service and advisory questions.
family.staleDraft: Your family was edited elsewhere. Your draft was kept; reopen the current records before saving.
